title: केसरिया बालम (Kesariya Balam)
opening_lines: केसरिया बालम आओ नी, पधारो म्हारे देस।
english_translation: O saffron-turbaned beloved, come grace our land with your presence.
cultural_notes: Official cultural welcome anthem of Rajasthan, sung in the royal courtly Maand raga by Allah Jilai Bai and Gavari Devi.

title: घूमर (Ghoomar Folk Song)
opening_lines: म्हारी घूमर छै नखराली ए माँ, घूमर रमवा म्हें जास्यां।
english_translation: O mother, my swirling Ghoomar is charmingly graceful; we shall go dance the Ghoomar.
cultural_notes: Celebrated at Gangaur, Teej, and royal weddings as daughters dance with grace.

title: चिरमी (Chirmi)
theme: Longing for parental home (पीहर री ओळूँ)
opening_lines: चिरमी रा डाला चार, वारी जाऊं चिरमी नै। म्हारो बीरो आयो सा, बाबोसा भेज्यो सा।
english_translation: The Chirmi vine has four branches, I adore the Chirmi vine. My brother has arrived to take me home, sent by my dear father.
cultural_notes: Deeply emotional song of a newlywed bride waiting atop the roof for her brother to arrive from her childhood village.

title: कुरजां (Kurjan)
opening_lines: कुरजां ए म्हारो भंवर मिला द्यो ए, साहिबा नै दीज्यो म्हारा राम-राम।
english_translation: O migratory crane (Kurjan), reunite me with my beloved; convey my respects to my master across distant lands.
cultural_notes: The Demoiselle cranes migrating to Kheechan (Phalodi) in thousands become the poetic messengers of love.

title: गोरबंद (Gorbandh)
opening_lines: म्हारी गोरबंद नखरालो, आलीजा म्हारो गोरबंद नखरालो।
english_translation: My ornate camel-neck ornament is truly majestic, O beloved my Gorbandh is graceful.
cultural_notes: Celebrates the loving hand-weaving of cowrie shells, beads, and colored wool ribbons (Gorbandh) to adorn the camel.
